features.name: User Registration and Authentication
features.description: Students can create accounts using university email, login, and manage their profiles
user_stories: As a student, I want to register with my university email so that I can access the platform
As a user, I want to login securely so that I can access my notes and groups
As a user, I want to update my profile information so that others can know more about me
acceptance_criteria: Registration requires valid university email domain
Email verification is required before account activation
Password must meet security requirements (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number)
Users can reset password via email
Profile includes name, major, year, and bio

features.name: Note Upload and Management
features.description: Students can upload, organize, edit, and delete their study notes
user_stories: As a student, I want to upload my study notes so that I can share them with others
As a student, I want to organize my notes by course and topic so that they are easy to find
As a student, I want to edit or delete my notes so that I can keep them up to date
As a student, I want to add tags to my notes so that they are discoverable
acceptance_criteria: Supports PDF, DOCX, and TXT file formats
Maximum file size of 10MB per note
Notes must be associated with a course and subject
Users can only edit/delete their own notes
Notes include title, description, course, tags, and upload date

features.name: Note Discovery and Search
features.description: Students can search and browse notes shared by other students
user_stories: As a student, I want to search for notes by course name so that I can find relevant study materials
As a student, I want to filter notes by tags and topics so that I can narrow down results
As a student, I want to see the most popular notes so that I can access high-quality content
As a student, I want to preview notes before downloading so that I can verify relevance
acceptance_criteria: Search supports course name, tags, and keywords
Results can be sorted by date, popularity, and rating
Preview shows first page or excerpt of note
Search results display note title, author, course, upload date, and rating

features.name: Study Group Creation and Management
features.description: Students can create study groups, invite members, and manage group settings
user_stories: As a student, I want to create a study group for my course so that I can collaborate with peers
As a group admin, I want to invite students to join my group so that we can study together
As a group admin, I want to manage group members so that I can remove inactive users
As a student, I want to leave a group so that I can manage my commitments
acceptance_criteria: Groups have a name, description, course association, and privacy setting (public/private)
Group creator becomes admin by default
Admins can invite members, remove members, and delete the group
Members can leave groups voluntarily
Maximum 50 members per group

features.name: Group Discussion Forum
features.description: Group members can post messages, ask questions, and discuss topics within their study groups
user_stories: As a group member, I want to post messages in my group so that I can communicate with peers
As a group member, I want to reply to posts so that I can participate in discussions
As a group member, I want to receive notifications for new posts so that I stay updated
As a group member, I want to search past discussions so that I can find answers to questions
acceptance_criteria: Only group members can view and post in group forums
Posts support text and file attachments
Users can edit and delete their own posts
Posts display author, timestamp, and content
Notifications sent for new posts in groups user belongs to

features.name: Note Rating and Reviews
features.description: Students can rate and review notes to help others identify quality content
user_stories: As a student, I want to rate notes I've downloaded so that I can help others find good content
As a student, I want to write reviews for notes so that I can provide detailed feedback
As a student, I want to see average ratings so that I can identify high-quality notes
As a note author, I want to see feedback on my notes so that I can improve them
acceptance_criteria: Rating scale is 1-5 stars
Users can only rate notes they have downloaded
Users can write optional text reviews
Average rating is displayed on note listings
Users can edit their own ratings and reviews

features.name: User Dashboard
features.description: Students have a personalized dashboard showing their notes, groups, and activity
user_stories: As a student, I want to see all my uploaded notes in one place so that I can manage them easily
As a student, I want to see my groups on my dashboard so that I can access them quickly
As a student, I want to see recent activity so that I can stay updated
As a student, I want to see my download history so that I can re-access notes
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays user's uploaded notes
Dashboard shows all groups user is a member of
Recent activity includes downloads, uploads, and group posts
Dashboard is the landing page after login

features.name: Notification System
features.description: Users receive notifications for relevant activities and updates
user_stories: As a user, I want to receive notifications when someone joins my group so that I can welcome them
As a user, I want to be notified when my notes are rated so that I can see feedback
As a user, I want to receive notifications for group posts so that I can participate in discussions
As a user, I want to manage my notification preferences so that I control what I receive
acceptance_criteria: Notifications appear in-app
Users can mark notifications as read
Notification types include: group invites, new members, note ratings, group posts
Users can enable/disable notification types in settings

constraints: Must verify university email domains before allowing registration
Must comply with data privacy regulations (GDPR, FERPA)
File uploads limited to 10MB per file
Platform must be accessible via web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Budget constraints require use of open-source technologies where possible
non_functional_requirements: Performance: Page load time must be under 2 seconds
Performance: Search results must return within 1 second
Scalability: System must support up to 10,000 registered users
Security: All passwords must be hashed using bcrypt or similar
Security: All data transmission must use HTTPS/TLS encryption
Security: File uploads must be scanned for malware
Availability: System uptime of 99.5% during academic terms
Usability: Interface must be intuitive with minimal training required
Usability: Platform must be responsive and work on mobile devices
Accessibility: Must meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards
Maintainability: Code must follow established style guides and be well-documented
Backup: Daily automated backups of database and uploaded files
Recovery: System must be recoverable within 4 hours of failure
